component.name: Race the Nags
component.summary: Race horses and place play-money bets with friends

description.p: Pick a horse, place a play-money bet and watch the race with up to six players sharing a screen. Each player starts with a fictional bankroll, and all bets and payouts stay inside the game.
Choose Original racing rules or Remastered mode with persistent speed, stamina, consistency and recent form. Switch between Classic, Enhanced and Animated graphics without changing the race.

ul.li: Win, Place and Show bets, plus multi-horse bets in Remastered mode
Manual play or automatic racing strategies
Saved games, remembered player names and racing records

description.p: This independent tribute includes original and creator-supplied enhanced images under separate rights notices. These images are excluded from the MIT licence. Additional redistribution permission for the original graphics has not been documented; consult the distribution notices.

screenshot.caption: A race with the creator-supplied enhanced graphics

description.p: Add a new horse app icon across desktop builds and the website, and an optional Linux application-menu installer.
Keep automatic racing active when switching windows.
Restore the creator-supplied enhanced portrait and horse sprite sheets.
